system.description: Beginning at 17th Level, even the boldest shinobi whisper of you, saying to never face you without backup. But even backup won’t save them. When you would cast a Taijutsu that requires you to make 2 or more attacks and there are at least two or more hostile creatures within the jutsu’s range, you may spend 3 Martial Die, when you do, all hostile creatures in range become targets of your Taijutsu attacks, applying the results of the jutsu’s attacks against each creatures AC.
